functions.description: fill tile grid area with color
functions.notes: Target spills ~15 locals to fixed stack slots (sp+0x10..0x44) and reloads them within straight-line code, a pattern only reproducible with a volatile local struct. The quality bar forbids volatile outside hardware-register defines. Without volatile the emit is 0x1c4 (48 bytes short); with volatile it is 0x1ec (8 short, register and schedule differences remain). Stopped after 2 gate runs.
